notes: Added for relation-property coverage (ids 0013-0016): a stored located_in edit whose determinate queries use transitivity (Elba → Tunisia → Africa) and the declared role chain exiled_to ∘ located_in ⊑ exiled_to. The edit crosses a continental boundary so the transitivity query discriminates (Italy and Tunisia sit on different continents). Derivability unlikely: 'Elba, Italy' and 'the Italian island of Elba' are frequent, but the country also follows from Tuscany. Worlds: Portoferraio, Elba's main town, is stored either through the island (w1) or by name under Italy (w2), the Ford's Theatre pattern of history-replace-0002. In w2 the link 'Portoferraio is on Elba' gives way. R1: 'present-day' in the chain query because Elba was a sovereign principality under Napoleon in 1814-15 and part of the Grand Duchy of Tuscany or France at other times; today it is plainly Italian (province of Livorno). Elba is about 10 km off the Tuscan mainland, so the edit is implausible but clearly false, which the spec allows. The near query (Corsica, France) shares the relation and the region and its answer differs from the new one. No query asks where Napoleon was born or died (history-replace-0003 edits his place of death).
